final_access: collect only after geometry/gate/encoder/probe selection freeze

gate.main_overlap_gate: only actual overlapping projective surfaces; no main presence requirement

selection.hybrid_surface: post-erosion-fallback/pre2048/SOR k16 std2 candidates BEFORE legacy final FPS; structural anchors protected; anchored global FPS
selection.hybrid_overflow: stable source-ID-seeded spatial FPS of structural anchors only
selection.dedup: greedy structural-priority then stable source-ID representative within3mm; retain representative measured XYZ/F5 and attach other source IDs

training.selection: minimum validation geometry loss every50 updates; first tie
training.geometry_candidate_gate: exclude only invalid/leaking/nonfinite contracts; empirical suitability separately reported

suitability.aggregation: episode macro mean; paired conditions same episode/frame/object/budget; evaluation only after freeze
suitability.GO: all supported primary perception/geometry/representation criteria pass with nonzero denominators
suitability.CONDITIONAL: coverage benefit with at least one material failure or unsupported required stratum; do not infer closed-loop success
suitability.NO_GO: coverage benefit absent or contamination/missing materially worsens on final
